steps.instruction:
交付驗證鏈圖、三類負/正例及索引比較表。
在交接件中加入「Android Verified Boot：資產、信任邊界與測試資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：用合成bootloader、vbmeta與分割區清單畫驗證鏈；分開標示簽章有效、裝置鎖定狀態與rollback index，不對真實手機解鎖或刷機。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：用合成bootloader、vbmeta與分割區清單畫驗證鏈；分開標示簽章有效、裝置鎖定狀態與rollback index，不對真實手機解鎖或刷機。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the verification-chain diagram, three validation cases and index comparisons.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Android Verified Boot：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures: Map bootloader, vbmeta and partitions from synthetic records; distinguish signature validity, device lock state and rollback index without unlocking or flashing a real phone. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Map bootloader, vbmeta and partitions from synthetic records; distinguish signature validity, device lock state and rollback index without unlocking or flashing a real phone. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。用合成bootloader、vbmeta與分割區清單畫驗證鏈；分開標示簽章有效、裝置鎖定狀態與rollback index，不對真實手機解鎖或刷機。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Map bootloader, vbmeta and partitions from synthetic records; distinguish signature validity, device lock state and rollback index without unlocking or flashing a real phone. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 用合成bootloader、vbmeta與分割區清單畫驗證鏈；分開標示簽章有效、裝置鎖定狀態與rollback index，不對真實手機解鎖或刷機。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.checkEn: Map bootloader, vbmeta and partitions from synthetic records; distinguish signature validity, device lock state and rollback index without unlocking or flashing a real phone. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Android Verified Boot驗證開機信任鏈，並以回滾保護避免接受低於記錄要求的版本狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Android Verified Boot checks the boot trust chain and uses rollback protection against states below recorded requirements.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 用合成bootloader、vbmeta與分割區清單畫驗證鏈；分開標示簽章有效、裝置鎖定狀態與rollback index，不對真實手機解鎖或刷機。
knowledge.textEn: Map bootloader, vbmeta and partitions from synthetic records; distinguish signature validity, device lock state and rollback index without unlocking or flashing a real phone.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學回滾判定要求候選index≥已記錄最低index，且簽章與其他驗證通過；差值是索引間距，不是安全強度或版本年齡。
knowledge.textEn: The teaching rollback rule requires candidate index≥stored minimum plus valid signatures and other checks; index difference is neither strength nor version age.
